ModMetaData.name: M3AT: Maru's 3D Animated Toons
ModMetaData.author: maru mirai
ModMetaData.description:
Animated 3D pawns for IsoRim Waylith
WIP, current features include: Anims for most actions (some currently basic) Wearable 3D apparel, Sprite-to-3D hairs Handling animations for IsoRim's weapons Visible holstered weapons and IsoRim equipment Body types, Gene parts, Biotech growth, Prosthetics Visible injuries, Injury-reactive animations Ragdolls and flinging Freecam mode CE support Optimization where possible
Discord: https://discord.gg/7t5Aav2f2e GitHub: https://github.com/MaruMirai/M3AT
Chibi Base Body by monymensss (Sketchfab), CC BY 4.0, rigged and reshaped here. Licences: see LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
